name: Blocky Deathmatch
hook: A first-person arena made of plain blocks.
how: Run, jump and shoot in a small block arena. Climb the crates to the middle platform, grab health packs that come back on a timer, and be first to 15 frags.
controls: WASD and mouse, click to shoot, Space to jump. On a phone: left thumb moves, drag to look, FIRE shoots
uses: The most frags anyone has scored in one match.
One player's browser keeps the frags, the timer and the winner; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots run, aim and shoot until enough people join.
Every player moves and shoots for everyone at once.
ideas: Add a rocket launcher with splash damage
Set the arena on a moving train
